name: EkycVerifyV2

parameters.help_en: A unique business identifier customized by the merchant, used for subsequent troubleshooting. Supports a combination of letters and digits with a length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持长度为 32 位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: A custom user ID or other identifier that can identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you desensitize the value of this field in advance, for example, by hashing the value
parameters.help_zh: 您自定义的用户 ID，或者其他可以识别特定用户的标识，例如：手机号码、邮箱地址等。强烈建议对该字段的值进行预先脱敏，例如对值进行哈希处理
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en: The real name of the user. When Authorize='T' and the document type is a mainland China ID card, at least one of the following groups must be provided: document key information (DocName, DocNo) or document image (IdOcrPictureBase64/URL). Note: Supports combinations of Chinese characters with a length of at least 1 character. Special characters are not supported, except for the middle dot (·) used in ethnic minority names
parameters.help_zh: 用户的真实姓名。当 Authorize='T'且证件类型为大陆身份证时，证件关键信息（DocName、DocNo）与证件图片（IdOcrPictureBase64/URL)必须至少输入其中一组 注：支持长度为 1 个汉字以上的汉字组合，无特殊字符，少数民族的点【·】除外
parameters.name: doc_name

parameters.help_en: The document number of the user. When Authorize='T' and the document type is a mainland China ID card, at least one of the following groups must be provided: document key information (DocName, DocNo) or document image (IdOcrPictureBase64/URL). Note: Supports a combination of letters and digits with a length of 18 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户的证件号。当 Authorize='T'且证件类型为大陆身份证时，证件关键信息（DocName、DocNo）与证件图片（IdOcrPictureBase64/URL)必须至少输入其中一组 注：支持长度为 18 位的字母和数字组合
parameters.name: doc_no

parameters.help_en: The URL of the front side of the document image
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded document image. Note:

If you use this method to pass the document image, check the photo size and do not pass an overly large photo.
You can only specify one of IdOcrPictureBase64, IdOcrPictureUrl, and IdOcrPictureFile
parameters.help_zh:
卡证图片 Base64 编码。 说明

如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
IdOcrPictureBase64 和 IdOcrPictureUrl 和 IdOcrPictureFile 三选一
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The file stream of the front side of the document image
parameters.help_zh: 证件正面图片 文件流
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_file

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face photo
parameters.name: face_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded face image.

Note:

If you use this method to pass the face image, check the photo size and do not pass an overly large photo.
You can only specify one of FacePictureBase64, FacePictureUrl, and FacePictureFile
parameters.help_zh:
人像图片 Base64 编码。

说明

如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
FacePictureBase64 和 FacePictureUrl 和 FacePictureFile 三选一
parameters.name: face_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The file stream of the face photo
parameters.name: face_picture_file

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cropping is allowed. Not allowed by default. Valid values: T and F.

T: Cropping is allowed.
F: Cropping is not allowed. (Default: F)
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许裁剪，默认不允许，T/F

T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认 F）
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authoritative identity verification. Currently, this feature is applicable only to second-generation ID cards of mainland China
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启身份权威核验，目前仅适用于中国大陆二代身份证
parameters.name: authorize

parameters.help_en:
The custom OCR quality detection threshold mode:

0: System default.
1: Strict mode.
2: Lenient mode.
3 (Default): Quality detection is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
自定义 OCR 质量检测阈值模式：

0：系统默认
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The document recognition result. This parameter is returned only when the API response is successful
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 卡证识别结果 只有当接口响应成功时返回

Passed.description_en: Indicates whether the verification is passed. Valid values: Y (passed) and N (not passed)
Passed.description_zh: 是否通过，通过为 Y，不通过为 N

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the authentication request
